title: Eye detection overlay toggle and bounding box rendering
description: Implement web/src/components/DetectionOverlay.jsx to draw face and eye bounding boxes with closed probability labels (green for open, red for closed) over the live video canvas, controlled by a 'Show Facial Landmarks / Overlays' toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders detected eye bounding boxes with label showing 'Open X.XX' or 'Closed X.XX'
Boxes are styled green when open and red when closed
Overlay visibility responds dynamically to the 'Show Overlays' toggle switch without restarting camera
Handles zero detections cleanly without rendering ghost boxes

steps.details: Create web/src/components/DetectionOverlay.jsx positioning an absolute SVG or HTML5 canvas layer directly on top of the video feed.

steps.description: Implement box coordinate scaling and drawing
steps.details: Scale relative bounding box coordinates (x, y, w, h) to video canvas dimensions and render SVG rects with text tags.
Hide overlay layer when showOverlays is false to allow uncluttered monitoring view (PRD FR-02).
Run Playwright test toggling overlay checkbox and verifying box elements exist; take screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-24-1.png.

technicalNotes: Use SVG vector overlays to avoid blurry canvas scaling.
Keep overlay lightweight to preserve 30 FPS render speed.
